title: The Tail at Scale
supported_summary: Tail latency and redundant/hedged requests motivate a delayed backup rather than unconditional fan-out.
limitations: Application to desktop context retrieval is our design inference, not a measured result for this app.

title: Making retries safe with idempotent APIs
supported_summary: A caller request identifier and atomic recording of an operation reduce duplicate side effects on retries.
limitations: A local journal alone cannot provide exactly-once effects in an external service.

title: Playwright isolation
supported_summary: Browser contexts separate cookies and browser storage for independent sessions.
limitations: Browser contexts do not isolate writes to the same remote account; they are not full OS sandboxes.

title: Git worktree
supported_summary: Multiple working trees can be attached to one repository.
limitations: Worktrees share Git administration; this is not credential, process or filesystem security isolation.

title: UFO
supported_summary: UFO3 documents dynamic task DAGs and parallel orchestration; UFO2 is the device-agent layer.
limitations: Not installed or benchmarked on the user Dell. Use as an optional adapter, not a second authority.

title: Laya model card
supported_summary: Typed decision models and multilingual/typed checkpoints are available; the card itself reports variable accuracy with domain and input length.
limitations: No 33ms or near-perfect routing promise on this Dell; decision confidence does not grant execution permission.

title: Unsloth decision Laya
supported_summary: Documents local decision-model serving, including CPU execution and optional GPU.
limitations: Model execution and deployment are untested in this pack; pin a reviewed version before installation.

title: GLiNER
supported_summary: Entity extraction accepts user-supplied entity labels.
limitations: Candidate span extraction is not proof of a task being completed or a permission being granted. Russian/code-mixed evaluation is required.

title: SCIP
supported_summary: A protocol for code intelligence with ecosystem language indexers.
limitations: Choose a supported indexer; syntax parsing alone does not produce a complete runtime call graph.

title: Docling
supported_summary: Document conversion can provide structured inputs to context pipelines.
limitations: Optional parser only. Raw files, page offsets and parser errors still need separate retention. No OCR was used in this delivery.

title: DSPy
supported_summary: Modular model pipelines and optimization of prompts/weights.
limitations: Use held-out evaluation; do not tune and report on the same voice/repo cases.

title: GEPA
supported_summary: Reflective optimization evaluates candidate textual parameters and uses execution feedback.
limitations: Our proposed use is offline context-policy/skill optimization, not uncontrolled self-modification.

title: GEPA paper
supported_summary: Research basis for reflective optimization.
limitations: Reported task results do not transfer automatically to PC control or flashloan qualification.

title: OpenTelemetry traces
supported_summary: Trace spans describe causally related operations and timing.
limitations: Tracing does not itself validate outcome correctness; keep source/effect receipts separately.

title: Artifact attestations
supported_summary: Attestations support verification of artifact build provenance.
limitations: Provenance is not proof of safe code. Permission diff, tests and local health check remain necessary.

title: MCP specification
publisher: Official specification; current landing page redirected here during read
supported_summary: Current specification links Tasks and Skills over MCP extensions.
limitations: Negotiate supported capabilities per client; not every AI web tab supports those extensions.

title: Plugin submission
publisher: OpenAI official documentation; apps-sdk submission redirected here
supported_summary: Directory publication has package validation, review and publication steps.
limitations: A URL field or a personal connector is not automatic public listing. The earlier UI icon was not identified.

title: Agent Skills
supported_summary: A skill is a folder with SKILL.md and optional resources/scripts.
limitations: Instructions in a skill are not OS permission enforcement.

title: LangGraph persistence
supported_summary: Checkpointed graph state is a candidate for resumable agent workflows.
limitations: Do not add a parallel production queue over the existing SCE Core without a migration ADR.

title: Introducing System One Models & Jev
supported_summary: State plus typed probabilistic decisions; host software owns surrounding workflow.
limitations: Type correctness is not semantic truth; performance figures are vendor claims, not Dell tests.

title: Building a Harness with Jev
supported_summary: Classifier middleware, model routing and structured decisions; links to browser and email demos on X.
limitations: Direct X posts failed to open here; the article is not independent verification of those demos.

title: Node/TypeScript Laya runtime
supported_summary: ONNX Runtime route for Node/TypeScript without Python at inference time.
limitations: Optional experiment; CPU/RAM, numeric parity and context truncation require local conformance tests.

title: Laya Candle runtime
supported_summary: Rust/Candle local Laya port exists.
limitations: No Windows installation or performance comparison performed; not assumed equivalent to reference implementation.

title: screenpipe
supported_summary: Accessibility-first/event-driven capture and local history can be an optional observation adapter.
limitations: Current source-available license and telemetry defaults need review; not described here as unrestricted open source or zero-network by default.

title: UI Automation events
supported_summary: UI Automation clients can receive relevant UI events rather than constantly polling everything.
limitations: Accessibility providers may be incomplete; this source does not promise all app contents or complete history.

title: xAI function calling
supported_summary: Model tool requests can be executed by client-side code and results returned to the model.
limitations: An API key or model response alone does not mount the PC or grant GitHub rights.

title: ChatGPT/API billing
supported_summary: ChatGPT subscription and API-platform billing are managed separately.
limitations: An API key is not an included Pro API credit allowance; separate supported sign-in products require their own eligibility check.

title: Computer use
supported_summary: Computer-use actions require an execution environment and an observe/act loop.
limitations: Optional fallback only; not a test of autonomous safety or device compatibility.
